description: A product is an instance of exactly one product line (PP-T20 belongs to PP改性系列). The product line is a category label over products, not a component of a product.
A supplier is an instance of a supplier category (树脂/助剂/包装).

connection_condition: dim_hazard.risk_level carries a value from the dim_risk_level catalogue
description: A hazard is graded into one risk level (L1可接受/L2可容忍/...); the hazard's risk_value domain is a subset of the risk-level catalogue domain.

connection_condition: dim_downtime_reason is a specialised reason family alongside dim_reason_code
description: The eight downtime reasons (D001 设备故障 ... D008 滤网更换) are a specialised subfamily of the general reason vocabulary: they play the same role of labelling why something happened, but their value domain is a subset scoped to equipment downtime.

connection_condition: dim_workshop.factory_name ties a workshop to its factory
description: A factory is composed of workshops (青岛一厂 -> PP改性车间/PA改性车间). A workshop cannot exist without its factory.
A workshop is composed of production lines (PP改性车间 -> PP挤出1/2/3线). This is the hop that makes workshop-scoped production questions reachable from the workshop name.

connection_condition: dim_warehouse.factory_name ties a warehouse to its factory
description: A factory owns the raw-material and finished-goods warehouses located on it (一厂原料仓/一厂成品仓/二厂原料仓/二厂成品仓/合肥原料仓/合肥成品仓).
Sensors are mounted on equipment, so a sensor reading inherits the equipment context; the sensor code itself encodes the equipment it belongs to.
A business unit is composed of cost centers (特种材料事业部 contains CC005 特种工程塑料车间). This is the second hop needed to reach a business unit from a cost-bearing fact table.

connection_condition: dim_profit_center is attributed to a business unit
description: A business unit is composed of profit centers; profit centers are the management-accounting counterpart of cost centers.
A department is composed of the employees assigned to it (dim_department has 17 departments spanning sales regions and functions).
A department operates one or more cost centers, which is where its expense is collected.
Output records belong to a production order and cannot exist without it.

Production output is booked per production order.
Material consumption is booked against a production order; 实际投料 is actual_qty on this table.
Labor bookings are reported per production order.
Work-in-process snapshots are taken per production order.
Rework orders reference the originating production order.
Scrap events are recorded against a production order.
Tool usage is booked per production order.
Inspection lots are created per production order.

connection_condition: dim_region.region_name holds the same values as the denormalized fact_*.sales_region text column
description: The region concept is materialised twice: as a proper dimension (dim_region: 华东/华南/华北/西南/华中/西北) and as a denormalized sales_region text column repeated across 8 fact tables. Both carry the same six values, so a region filter can be answered in place or through the dimension.

connection_condition: Both tables carry the same business meaning 'environmental monitoring' but with different column sets
description: The environmental-monitoring concept exists as two tables: an early table without the governance envelope (record_date/measured_value/limit_value/is_compliant) and the standard env table with the full envelope (business_date/emission_value/evidence_reference). They are two groundings of one concept at different scope, not row-equivalent copies.

connection_condition: fact_condition_monitoring.reading_value and fact_iot_data.value hold the same readings for the same sensor_id
description: The sensor measurement is exposed as reading_value on fact_condition_monitoring and as value on fact_iot_data. The two tables hold identical readings for the same 180 sensors (28758 rows, sum 5151284.7 each), so summing both double-counts the same stream.

connection_condition: fact_predictive_alert.reading_value uses the same measure name and unit set as fact_condition_monitoring.reading_value
description: Both tables carry reading_value together with reading_unit, so '传感器测量值/读数单位' has two candidate groundings that must be separated by question intent (continuous monitoring vs alert rows).

connection_condition: fact_downtime.reason_code holds integer ids into dim_downtime_reason while fact_equipment_runtime.downtime_reason holds the Chinese name text
description: The same downtime-reason concept is persisted two ways: an integer code on fact_downtime and a free-text Chinese name on fact_equipment_runtime. A name filter such as 滤网更换 matches the text form only.

Currency is materialised as a dimension (dim_currency.currency_code with exchange_rate and decimals) and as a denormalized currency_code text column on ~40 fact tables, each accompanied by an exchange_rate column. Grouping by currency name needs the dimension; grouping by code can be done in place.

connection_condition: fact_labor_booking.employee_no holds E-codes (E0061, E0062, E0056) identifying the same people as dim_employee.emp_id
description: A third person-identifier namespace: E-codes appear on the HR-domain fact tables (fact_labor_booking, fact_skill_assessment, fact_certification_record, fact_employee_assignment, fact_overtime), separate from the integer emp_id and from the U-code audit columns.

connection_condition: Both columns belong to the same governance envelope on the same 92 tables
description: status and the audit user/timestamp columns travel together as one envelope, so a question about approval state and a question about the approver touch the same table family.

connection_condition: Both are timestamp columns of the audit envelope present on the same 92 tables
description: The two timestamps carry distinct roles (last update vs approval) but share type, grain and nullability patterns, which is a common source of the wrong year column being selected.

connection_condition: Both are date columns of the envelope but at different levels: created_at is the record-writing timestamp, business_date the business occurrence date
description: A year filter phrased as 创建 references created_at while an unqualified year usually references business_date/posting_date. Choosing the wrong one changes the filtered set.

connection_condition: local_amount is the base-currency result of converting amount at exchange_rate
description: Base-currency amount is derived from the transaction amount and its exchange rate; a CNY row has exchange_rate 1 and local_amount equal to amount.

connection_condition: fact_capex_project_cost rows carry both currency_code and exchange_rate
description: Ranking currencies by summed exchange rate is a derivation over the rate column grouped by the currency column.

connection_condition: fact_production_order carries planned_quantity, actual_quantity and yield_rate on one row
description: 成材率 is defined in the metric catalog as 实际产量/投料量x100, i.e. a derived metric over the production order's quantity columns and its material consumption.

connection_condition: fact_production_plan holds planned_quantity, actual_quantity and plan_achievement at line-by-month grain
description: 计划达成率 is derived as actual over planned; the plan table expresses its period as year+month integers rather than a date.

connection_condition: fact_production_output holds quantity, grade, is_first_grade and first_grade_rate
description: 优等品率 is the share of first-grade output in total output, a derived ratio rather than a stored count.

connection_condition: fact_ap.amount is documented over the goods-receipt quantity and the purchase unit price
description: The documented AP rule is amount = 收货数量 x 采购单价 x 1.13, with due_date = 收货当月月末 + 账期天数; paid_amount then closes the item, giving the 已付金额 measure.

connection_condition: fact_ar_aging derives current_month, the aging buckets and overdue_months from due_date
description: 账龄 (当前账龄(月)=current_month, aging_1m..aging_12m_plus, overdue_months) is derived from the due date relative to the reporting date, so a 当前账龄(月) question resolves to a stored derived column.

connection_condition: fact_lot_trace holds bom_qty_per_ton, standard_quantity and usage_variance_rate
description: 用量差异率 is derived from the standard BOM quantity and the actual issued quantity.

connection_condition: DWS_* tables are aggregations over the detail fact tables and are documented as reconcilable with them
description: The 16 DWS summary tables re-express the detail measures at a coarser grain (person/day, day/month); they are a derived view of the same facts, not additional facts.

connection_condition: dim_metric_catalog.dws_table / date_column / value_column point at the DWS summary tables
description: The metric catalog is the declared derivation contract for the DWS layer: each catalog row names the metric, its category (原子/派生/复合指标) and the table, date column and value column that realise it.

U-code system users and dim_employee staff both denote 'a person' in questions, but there is no shared identifier: no U-code appears in dim_employee and no emp_id appears in the audit columns, so the link cannot be resolved by a join.

Several different fact families reference material_id and also carry tax_amount (supplier quality issues, ASN lines, transfer lines, supplier contract lines), so '税额合计最高的原材料' cannot be grounded on the material concept alone; the business document family must come from the question.
Sales-lead dates are joined to the shared calendar to reach a calendar or holiday name; the lead table itself carries no calendar attribute.

The generic reason_code column is physically present on the transfer line table (and on ~69 tables) but is constant there, so the reason dictionary is not reachable with any discriminating result. The association exists by name only.

connection_condition: dim_hazard.hazard_category and fact_hazard_observation.hazard_type share the value domain 物理性/化学性/人机工程
description: 危险类型 is available both denormalized on the observation table and in the hazard dimension; either grounding answers the same filter, but only the dimension carries location and risk_level.
Customer status (active/dormant/lost) is an attribute of the customer dimension while the aging measures live on the AR aging fact, so a status-filtered aging question spans both.

connection_condition: dim_supplier.supplier_id reaches fact_payment_out only indirectly through fact_ap.supplier_id
description: Supplier-scoped payment questions need a two-hop path (supplier -> AP item -> outgoing payment) because the payment table itself carries no supplier column.
AP items are created one per qualified goods receipt, so '已过账收货单对应的应付账款' traverses receipt to AP item.
Safety audits are scoped to a workshop, giving workshop-level safety rollups.
Energy consumption is recorded per workshop and line, so workshop names from the production hierarchy also address the energy table.
The scrap table carries three reason-looking columns (reason_code, defect_code, root_cause_code) but all three are constant, so 报废原因 has no discriminating single-column grounding there.

connection_condition: Both tables carry monitoring_point and evidence-reference attributes of the same shape
description: Environmental measurement and emission events share the monitoring-point and evidence-reference attributes but sit at different grains (routine measurement vs emission occurrence).
Leads are attributed to customers and employees, so customer- or salesperson-level lead counts require these hops.

connection_condition: A fact table's business_date joins to dim_calendar.calendar_date to obtain holiday_name
description: Holiday-scoped questions (国庆节当天, '金额合计最高的那一天对应的节假日名称') require joining a fact table's date column to the shared calendar.

connection_condition: fact_maintenance_task links to equipment through the line/equipment context
description: Maintenance tasks, spare-part issues and downtime all describe the same equipment lifecycle from different angles, so an equipment-level question may need any of these tables.
Safety objectives are owned by a department (责任部门), so department-level objective totals require this hop.
KPI snapshots are evaluated per employee and department.
Overtime records are attributed to an employee and a department.

Data-quality issues are raised against datasets and validation cases while the metric catalog declares the metrics those datasets realise; the two are related through the dataset governance context rather than a direct key.
